name: Black Bear Diner Homestyle Meatloaf with Brown Gravy
brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (American Fork / Sandy, UT)
whyItWorks: Seasoned ground beef baked into classic meatloaf and served with brown gravy over mashed potatoes. Meat is soft and easy to chew, but contains onion seasoning and breading requiring baseline tolerance.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with smooth mashed potatoes and gravy. Discard outer heavily glazed crust if tomato sauce causes acid reflux.
